label: data:domain
evidence: Portable Game Notation: a plain-text, chess-domain data format for recording games (tag-pair header + SAN move list). Standardized by Steven J. Edwards in 1994 and widely used by chess engines (Stockfish, Komodo), databases (ChessBase), and online viewers (chess.com, lichess). Not a programming language — no execution semantics; it's structured data. Same shape as other `data:domain` examples in the vocabulary (.npy, .h5, .uasset).
